description: Look up the DNS records of any domain or hostname on any extension, live, through Cloudflare's public resolver: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, CAA, SOA and more, or the reverse DNS (PTR) of an IP address. Returns the records with their TTLs and the hivex.si page that explains what they mean.

name.description: A domain, hostname or IP address (e.g. 'example.com', '_dmarc.example.com', '8.8.8.8')

type.description: Record type; PTR for an IP address

name: dns_lookup

status.description: NOERROR, NXDOMAIN (the name does not exist), SERVFAIL…

title: Look up DNS records
